title: Sri Lanka Honeymoon: Kandy, Nuwara Eliya and Bentota
alt: Mist over the tea estates above Nuwara Eliya
transport: Private air conditioned car with an English speaking chauffeur guide throughout

stops.name: Kandy
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Standard class hotel on the Mahaweli river outside Kandy

activities.name: Private visit to Pinnawala
activities.description: A stop on the way up from the airport to watch the resident herd bathe in the Maha Oya river and feed at the sanctuary.

activities.name: Private half day Kandy sightseeing
activities.description: The Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, the giant Bahiravokanda Buddha above the town and the Royal Botanical Gardens at Peradeniya.

program.name: Kandy
program.description: One night by the river at Kandy with a private elephant visit on the way and a private half day of the city.

stops.name: Nuwara Eliya
stops.hotel: Tea Mount Forest Hotel, Nuwara Eliya
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Standard class hotel set among the tea gardens

activities.name: Private full day Nuwara Eliya sightseeing
activities.description: Ramboda Falls, a working tea estate and factory, Gregory Lake, Victoria Park, Hakgala gardens and the Seetha Amman temple.

program.name: Nuwara Eliya
program.description: Up into the tea country for a night in Little England with a private full day of its waterfalls, gardens and lake.

stops.name: Bentota
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Standard class beach resort on the Bentota shore

activities.name: Private Madu Ganga boat safari and Kosgoda turtle hatchery
activities.description: A boat through the mangrove islands of the Madu Ganga, then the turtle hatchery at Kosgoda.

activities.name: Bentota beach and the Galle fort
activities.description: A morning on the sand at Bentota, then the ramparts, lighthouse and old church of the Galle Dutch fort.

program.name: Bentota
program.description: Two nights on the beach: the Madu Ganga boat and the turtles on arrival, then Bentota beach and the Galle fort.

stops.name: Colombo
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast and dinner · Deluxe room · 4★ · Four star hotel on the Mount Lavinia beachfront south of the city

activities.name: Private full day Colombo sightseeing
activities.description: Galle Face Green, the Gangaramaya temple, the colonial Fort district, the Lotus Tower and the floating market at Pettah.

program.name: Colombo
program.description: A final night on the Mount Lavinia beachfront with a private full day of the capital.

day_titles.1: Arrival in Colombo and on to Kandy
day_titles.3: Down to the coast: Madu Ganga and the turtles

1: Arrival at Bandaranaike International and private transfer inland
A private stop at the Pinnawala elephant sanctuary
The Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic and the Peradeniya gardens
Check in by the river and dinner at the hotel
2: Breakfast and a private transfer up to Nuwara Eliya
Ramboda Falls and a tea factory tasting on the way
Gregory Lake, Victoria Park and the Hakgala gardens
Check in and dinner in Little England
3: Breakfast and a transfer down from the hills
A private boat safari through the Madu Ganga mangroves
Check in at Bentota and the evening on the beach
4: Breakfast and a morning on Bentota beach
Optional: jet ski or a banana boat ride at the river mouth
The Galle Dutch fort: ramparts, lighthouse and old church
Sunset from the walls and back to Bentota
5: Breakfast and a transfer down the coast to Colombo
Galle Face Green and the Gangaramaya temple complex
The Fort district, the Lotus Tower and Pettah market
Dinner and your last night at the hotel
6: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Bandaranaike International for your flight home

hotel_by_day.2: Tea Mount Forest Hotel, Nuwara Eliya

expert.name: Aditya
expert.role: Sri Lanka expert at Hi Tours
expert.quote: Bentota is where the trip exhales. After the temples and tea estates, three nights by the water is exactly the right medicine.
expert.tip: Ask for an early start on the Galle day. The fort ramparts are empty before ten and the light on the lighthouse is at its best.

summary: Six days for two: a night in Kandy with the elephants and the Tooth Relic temple, a night in the tea country, two nights at Bentota with the Madu Ganga boat, the turtles and the Galle fort, and a last night in Colombo.
included: Included: 5 nights in standard and deluxe class hotels with breakfast and lunch or dinner daily; private airport transfers and all road travel in an air conditioned car with chauffeur guide; private Pinnawala and half day Kandy sightseeing; private full day Nuwara Eliya sightseeing; private Madu Ganga boat safari and Kosgoda turtle hatchery; Bentota beach and a private Galle excursion; private full day Colombo sightseeing. Entrance tickets are payable locally.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Sri Lanka ETA visa fees; lunches unless stated; entrance tickets where marked as payable locally; travel insurance; optional excursions; tips and personal expenses.
